text: Autopsy report, London 1888: Victim's stomach contents included breakfast from restaurant that opened in 1923. Meal was still warm. Coroner noted subject died of starvation despite evidence of recent consumption.

Paleontological survey, Triassic period: Fossilized tree resin, 220 million BCE, preserves mosquito containing blood cells with synthetic insulin. Pharmaceutical patent dates to 1982. Amber formation predates mammals by 70 million years.

Municipal census, Bergen 1349: Population recorded as 4,847 living residents plus 12 citizens in good standing who have not yet been born. Tax assessments levied against the unborn. All twelve appeared by 1351.

Personnel records, Vatican 1503: Scribe employed to copy manuscripts died in 1499. Work continued uninterrupted. Handwriting analysis confirms same individual. Payroll clerk noted no anomaly in ledger.

Seismographic readings, Chile 1960: Earthquake magnitude 9.5 recorded tremors from impact event occurring in 1908 Tunguska. Temporal displacement of geological shock waves documented across 52year interval.

Archaeological survey, Bronze Age settlement: Storage jar from 1800 BCE contained grain still viable for planting. Seeds sprouted into wheat variety not cultivated until 1960s. Harvest yield exceeded modern agricultural standards by 300.

Diplomatic correspondence, Ottoman court 1683: Ambassador's report describes negotiating peace treaty with delegation from The Republic of Tomorrow. Treaty terms included temporal nonaggression pact. Document filed in active treaties until
Crossreference anomaly: Library patron returned book 23 years overdue. Checkout stamp shows future date. Book was destroyed in fire before patron was born. No late fees assessed.

Digital forensics lab, 1987: Technician analyzing floppy disk discovered file directory containing folders named after each day of the following year. December 31st folder held resignation letter from technician dated 1988.

Actuarial tables from London, 1666: Life expectancy calculations include provisions for citizens who died before birth. Seventeen cases documented. All premiums paid in full by nonexistent beneficiaries.

Structural survey, cathedral foundation 1204: Cornerstone contains compass rose pointing to directions that don't exist. Northwest and Southeast marked clearly. Magnetic readings confirm these directions pull true.
Archaeological survey, Pompeii 79 CE: Excavation of bakery revealed loaves of bread perfectly preserved but still warm. Temperature readings consistent for fortythree years of continuous monitoring.

Census data, rural Montana township, 1932: Population recorded as 847 residents. Current archaeological survey of township site reveals maximum sustainable population was 23 households. No records explain the mathematical discrepancy.

Meteorological archive, Lisbon 1755: Observatory recorded barometric pressure readings during earthquake. Instruments measured atmospheric density of grief. Scale calibrated in units that predate the concept of measurement.

Maritime log, whaling vessel Perseverance, 1834: Captain recorded harpooning same whale on seven consecutive days. Ship's surgeon confirmed whale showed no wounds. Crew consumed identical whale steaks nightly. Cargo hold remained empty.
